title: Sheinbaum Criticizes La Derecha Diario Following Cerimedo’s Arrest
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
content:
_This article by[José Shaddai Olvera
Torres](https://elchamuco.com.mx/author/shaddai/) originally appeared in the
[August 19, 2026 edition of El
Chamuco](https://elchamuco.com.mx/2026/08/19/sheinbaum-la-derecha-diario-
cerimedo/), a Mexican satirical political magazine._

**(AUGUST 19, 2026).—** The president questioned the use of **bots, artificial
intelligence, and fake news** by **La Derecha Diario** operators to influence
political processes.

During “The People’s Morning Conference,” Claudia Sheinbaum questioned the
role of La Derecha Diario following **the arrest in Bolivia of Fernando
Cerimedo** , one of the outlet’s founders and shareholders.

Cerimedo was arrested after the armed attack against his ex-partner, the
lawyer Nadia Beller, **who survived an attempted femicide**.

The Mexican president used the case to explain what, she argued, constitutes a
mechanism of political influence based on bots, artificial intelligence, and
the spread of fake news to favor right-wing movements in various countries.

### Sheinbaum Questions La Derecha Diario’s Digital Strategy

The president explained that La Derecha Diario uses digital tools to boost
content and build a network of information and opinion favorable to certain
right-wing political movements.

According to Sheinbaum, these tools include the use of bots and artificial
intelligence systems, which would make it possible to widen the reach of
certain content on social media.

The president linked this strategy to various political and electoral
processes in Latin America.

## Sheinbaum Shows a Post by Javier Negre

At another point in the conference, Sheinbaum showed a post by Javier Negre,
co-founder of La Derecha Diario along with Cerimedo.

The president used the content to argue that the project’s own members have
spoken publicly about their ability to influence electoral processes in
various Latin American countries.

According to Sheinbaum’s explanation, this strategy would seek to generate a
network of opinion by spreading content favorable to right-wing political
movements.

The president also stated that these operators had been **hired by Ricardo
Salinas Pliego**.

### The Case of Fernando Cerimedo

Sheinbaum’s remarks come after Fernando Cerimedo was arrested in Bolivia.

The Argentine is a personal adviser to Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz and has
also worked as a political consultant connected to Javier Milei.

Bolivian authorities consider him the main suspect in the attack against Nadia
Beller, **who was shot three times at the entrance of a hotel**.

During the conference, Sheinbaum also presented a post by Javier Negre and
described Cerimedo as a “femicide perpetrator.”

Cerimedo’s criminal liability for the attack, however, will have to be
determined through the corresponding investigation and judicial process.
